title: The data catalog and the standard questions: everything recorded is described by generated pages, and support opens a request id as a timeline
request: Phase 1's findability gap: what the studio records, where, in what shape, for how long and under which consent lived in prose that could drift; and the questions support and the owner ask most had no home. A generated catalog the gate keeps fresh, the standard questions as functions, a request id as a timeline; adoptable by the main product.
spec: dclab_core.catalog (the contract-derived half of the catalog) and dclab_core.queries (nine questions as pure functions); dclab_rnd.data_catalog writes docs/DATA_CATALOG.md and data_catalog.json from the contracts and the code and --check is a gate of make rd-gates; dclab_rnd/experience/queries.py reads the log and ledger for them (CLI query, GET /api/experience/queries/NAME); a request id is a filter of the log, finder.search, the route, the CLI and the Admin Sessions tab.
plan: The contract-derived parts (kinds with field classes, points, contracts) in dclab_core, so another host renders the same page.
The studio adds what only it knows: where each kind is emitted (by scanning the code), tables with files, retention, consent; a missing description fails the generator.
The nine questions as pure functions over lists; the studio's module reads the log and ledger.
A request filter through the log (files and PostgreSQL), the finder, the route, the CLI and the Admin form.
The drift gate in rd-gates and a test that every kind recorded in the code is in the vocabulary.

decisions.decision: The catalog is generated, never edited; descriptions live next to what they describe or in NOTES, and a table or builder with none fails the generator.
decisions.why: A page written by hand drifts; the gate that fails when something is added undescribed is what keeps it true.

decisions.decision: Where a kind is emitted is found by scanning the source for its quoted name.
decisions.why: No second list to keep; a kind nobody emits shows as emitted by the host.

decisions.decision: The questions are pure functions over lists in dclab_core, with the studio's reader beside them.
decisions.why: The main product asks the same questions of its adapted rows; the window is passed in, so nothing reads the clock.

decisions.decision: The request id is a filter of the log itself, not a text search.
decisions.why: It is indexed on PostgreSQL and a file store can skip nothing but the lines; text search would match the id inside other fields.

change: dclab_core catalog.py and queries.py (new), CHANGELOG 0.45.0; dclab_rnd data_catalog.py (new), experience/queries.py (new), experience/__init__.py (request filter on both logs), experience/finder.py, experience/__main__.py (query, --request), agentic/pages/sessions.py (queries route, request), accounts/guard.py, web admin.html (request field); Makefile (catalog, rd-gates); docs DATA_CATALOG.md and data_catalog.json (generated); tests test_data_catalog.py (new), test_experience_finder; CORE_INTEGRATION.md, the plan.

findings.defect: The first version put the question logic in the studio over its log, which the main product could not use.
findings.scenario: The Part D row says the queries run on its adapted rows.
findings.cause: Written against the log's read() before the adoptability rule was applied.
findings.fix: The logic moved into dclab_core.queries as pure functions over lists; the studio's module only reads and calls.

findings.defect: The drift test failed whenever any module that names a kind in quotes was added, because owners are scanned from the source.
findings.scenario: Adding dclab_core/queries.py changed 'emitted by' lists in the committed catalog.
findings.cause: The scan sees every file, as designed.
findings.fix: None needed: that is the gate working; the catalog is regenerated with make catalog.

findings.defect: 'What a deletion removes' undercounted: it read the newest 100,000 events and filtered them, and never counted the prompts the usage log keeps.
findings.scenario: A project whose events are older than the newest 100,000 showed 0 events; with DCLAB_LOG_PROMPTS=1 the most sensitive text a deletion clears was missing.
findings.cause: One capped, unfiltered read for every question.
findings.fix: One filtered read per id with no cap; a prompts row counted by the same rule forget_prompts clears; training counted in the store (stamped_counts).

findings.defect: 'Which model calls failed their check' read the transport outcome, not the check.
findings.scenario: A reply the model returned and cited.py rejected has outcome ok and showed nothing.
findings.cause: Check verdicts go to model_output_check, not to an event.
findings.fix: failed_calls adds the usage log's failing checks (purpose, tier, model, count, last reason).

findings.defect: The route and the Admin field refused request ids the server accepts.
findings.scenario: A proxy's X-Request-ID such as svc.7f3a9c01 is stored on events and got 422.
findings.cause: A looser id pattern than observe._VALID_ID.
findings.fix: The request id is validated by the server's own pattern.

findings.defect: The catalog's 'Emitted by' column listed readers: the adapter, the queries, the Admin page.
findings.scenario: graph.move showed the adapter, queries.py and admin.html and hid hooks.py behind '+3'.
findings.cause: Every module naming a kind in quotes was an owner.
findings.fix: Readers (the library, the finders, retention, the catalog, the Admin page) are left out; a kind no studio module names is the host's.

findings.defect: The request timeline printed a field a person typed (a token's label).
findings.scenario: what() returned name=Maryam's laptop for auth.token_created.
findings.cause: It did not check the field's class.

findings.defect: The catalog was thinner than the text asks: no owner for a decision point, a builder that needs no consent said it needed train, a missing file path.
findings.fix: Points carry where they are decided (ledger.CAPTURED), builders their own need, model_output_check its file; the consent and retention are global sections, said so in the plan.

findings.defect: overrides treated a shadow classifier's answer as the rule's; training said 'ready for training' for rows that can never leave.
findings.scenario: A shadow answer after a None rule value became 'the rule said'.
findings.cause: The answers were scanned without their source.
findings.fix: A shadow is skipped; training is retitled 'records by the level they were written under'.

outcome: docs/DATA_CATALOG.md lists every kind, point, audit kind, builder and table with its owner, retention and consent; the gate fails on drift; nine questions answer on the log, the route and the command line; a request id opens as a timeline. Reviewed: 7 findings fixed.
lessons: Apply the adoptability rule before writing the first version of a reader: a function over a log cannot be moved to another host, a function over a list can.
risks: The Admin page has the request field but no menu of the nine questions; the route and the command line have them.
Owners are found by quoted names: a kind built from variables would show as emitted by the host.
